pipelineNote: Current source format is mp3_44100_192, available on the current Creator plan. Decode provider MP3 to PCM WAV, level-match by constant gain toward -18 LUFS with a -1.5 dBTP ceiling, stitch and encode final 44.1 kHz MP3 at 192 kbps. This has one provider encode and one final encode. Legacy PCM clips remain available for history. Use exact --keys lists for bounded replacement runs.
